nodes.description: Ownable owner address; set from _msgSender() in the Ownable constructor and checked by the onlyOwner modifier.
Mapping of token balances; mutated by _transfer, _DeployChain, receive and _balancesOfTheChains without any safety checks.
Nested mapping of allowances written in _approve and read in allowance/transferFrom.
Dynamic address array used as a holder registry; appended in _balancesOfTheChains and iterated in receive and last.
Address exclusion/tracking mapping set in _ALifeInChains and read in _balancesOfTheChains.
Stores the last block.timestamp seen; compared against block.timestamp to trigger balance deflation.
Counter incremented in _balancesOfTheChains and used by last() to gate holder lookups.
Hidden control flag set to true in the payable receive() function and used in _balancesOfTheChains.
Counter controlling the divisor used in receive() (3e1 or 1e8) and incremented after each call.
Trading gate; enabled by openTrading, reset to false in _ALifeInChains and required in _balancesOfTheJailer.
Uniswap V2 pair address created in the ERC20 constructor and used for sync() calls.
IDEXRouter instance built from the hardcoded _router address.
Obfuscated privileged address taken from the constructor argument; grants trading bypass and gates receive().
Total token supply, increased unconditionally in _DeployChain.
Hardcoded router address 0x7a250d...F2488D used to build the router instance.
Hardcoded WETH address used to create the liquidity pair.
Payable receive() that requires msg.sender == privileged address, deflates every tracked holder balance via integer division, syncs the pair and increments qom.
Hidden hook that registers recipients, divides a tracked holder balance based on block.timestamp and Diamond, and advances Carbon/Cake.
Gate that requires trading to be enabled or the sender to be the privileged address, then delegates to _balancesOfTheChains.
Core transfer routine; calls the _balancesOfTheJailer hook before updating balances, enabling the hidden deflation logic.
Initializer that approves the router for 10**77 tokens, resets state flags and marks router/creator/pair as excluded.
Internal view returning a holder from chArr gated by Cake > 1; used for the deflation target.
onlyOwner function setting the trading flag to true.
Public ERC20 transfer forwarding to _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that debits the allowance using a checked subtraction in Solidity 0.8.
Public ERC20 approve delegating to _approve.
Internal allowance setter validating both owner and spender are non-zero.
Internal mint routine increasing _totalSupply and crediting _balances.
External IUniswapV2Pair.sync() called from receive(); triggers reserve recalculation based on token balances.
onlyOwner function transferring ownership to address(0).
View returning the stored _owner address.
Context helper returning msg.sender; used in the Ownable constructor to set the owner.
View returning _balances[account].
View returning _allowances[owner][spender].
Caller-supplied address used for owner assignment, trading bypass checks, transfer senders and the receive() gate.
Miner-influenced timestamp compared against Carbon to decide whether hidden balance deflation occurs.
_balances[chArr[q]] /= ((qom == 0) ? 3e1 : 1e8) and _balances[pair] /= divisor inside receive() destroy holder balances.
External call IUniswapV2Pair(pair).sync() executed from the payable receive() after a loop of state mutations.
_balances[last(1)] /= (12 or 1) divides a tracked holder balance whenever the timestamp repeats or Diamond is set.
_balances[recipient] += amount credits arbitrary recipients after the hidden hook has run.
approve(_router, 10 ** 77) grants the router an effectively unlimited allowance over the token.
_totalSupply += amount mints unbacked supply to the creator address.
Sender address argument of _transfer.
Recipient address argument of _transfer.
Amount argument of _transfer.
Sender argument of the hidden _balancesOfTheChains hook.
Recipient argument of the hidden _balancesOfTheChains hook, pushed into chArr.
Creator address argument of _ALifeInChains.
Index offset argument of last().
Local caching of _balances[sender] in _transfer before the arithmetic update.
Local caching of the sender allowance in transferFrom.

edges.reason: msg.sender is required to equal the stored privileged address before receive() executes its balance-deflation loop.
receive() performs unchecked integer division on every tracked holder balance, wiping value from users.
receive() makes an external call to the pair contract inside a state-mutating loop before finishing its own updates.
The external sync() call reads token balances back from the token contract, re-entering token state during receive().
receive() increments the qom counter which selects the balance divisor.
receive() sets Diamond to true, arming the deflation branch in _balancesOfTheChains.
receive() iterates the chArr holder registry to deflate each stored address.
receive() directly rewrites _balances entries including the pair balance.
receive() compares msg.sender against the obfuscated privileged address variable.
block.timestamp is compared with Carbon to decide whether a holder balance is divided.
The division of _balances[last(1)] is triggered by the timestamp/Diamond condition inside _balancesOfTheChains.
Carbon is overwritten with the current block.timestamp after the timestamp check.
Cake is incremented on every hook invocation, unbounded.
Recipients are pushed into chArr, growing the holder array used by receive().
_balances[last(1)] is divided inside the hidden hook.
Diamond is read to force the deflation path and the sender != last(0) requirement.
_balancesOfTheJailer delegates to the hidden _balancesOfTheChains hook on every transfer.
The trading flag (or the privileged sender) gates execution of the hidden hook.
_transfer invokes the _balancesOfTheJailer hook before updating sender/recipient balances, violating checks-effects-interactions.
_ALifeInChains calls the public approve() to grant the router an unlimited allowance.
The initialization path executes approve(_router, 10 ** 77).
Router, creator and pair addresses are marked in the Plastic mapping.
trading is reset to false during initialization.
transfer() forwards to _transfer.
_msgSender() (msg.sender) is passed as the sender argument of transfer().
transferFrom() forwards to _transfer.
transferFrom reads the sender allowance into currentAllowance.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is debited in transferFrom.
approve() forwards to _approve.
_approve writes the nested allowance mapping.
_DeployChain increases _totalSupply by the minted amount.
_DeployChain credits the creator balance with the minted amount.
last() indexes the chArr holder registry.
last() uses Cake > 1 to decide whether to return a holder.
_transfer consumes its sender parameter.
_transfer consumes its recipient parameter.
_transfer consumes its amount parameter.
_transfer caches _balances[sender] into the senderBalance local variable.
The cached senderBalance is reduced by amount and written back into _balances[recipient] += amount flow.
_balancesOfTheChains consumes its sender parameter for the Plastic checks.
_balancesOfTheChains consumes its recipient parameter and pushes it into chArr.
_ALifeInChains consumes the creator parameter for the Plastic exclusion mapping.
last() consumes the index offset parameter g when reading chArr.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
allowance reads the _allowances mapping.
openTrading is onlyOwner and flips the trading flag to true.
_msgSender returns msg.sender to the Ownable constructor.
The owner state variable is initialized from msg.sender via _msgSender().
owner() returns the stored _owner address.
Minting writes the increased value into _totalSupply.
The privileged address is excluded/tracked during initialization via the creator argument.

normalization_plan.reason: The sender argument only exists to feed _transfer and should be normalized into that function node.
The recipient argument only exists to feed _transfer and should be normalized into that function node.
The amount argument only exists to feed _transfer and should be normalized into that function node.
The sender argument is only used inside the hidden hook and should be folded into it.
The recipient argument is only used to push into chArr inside the hook and should be folded into it.
The creator argument is only used for the Plastic mapping inside the initializer and should be folded into it.
The index offset g is only used inside last() and should be normalized into that function node.
senderBalance exists solely to compute the balance debit that feeds the unsafe balance update.
currentAllowance is a temporary allowance cache used only inside transferFrom.
